notes.title: Character introduction ④ - Juri ＆Yurika
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36246473/108acd686359b7c1d9d668ce0f8c7ee45136ec9c.jpg[/img]
◆Juri Minase (Voiced by Nozomi Yamamoto)
Two-faced idol dreaming of the stars.
She wants to shine brighter than anyone else.
---------------------------
A student who both attends Belles Fleurs Academy and is active as a pop singer.
Her personality compels her to be the best at everything, and she sees herself as the cutest thing alive.
She's also extremely hostile to Hinata,
absolutely positive that the withering of the Grand Garden is due to the transfer student.

▼Character song
[previewyoutube=ZlxYxTMEag8;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36246473/ea6b77e0903561fe8d223758ddbfe0298f2347be.jpg[/img]
◆Yurika Murasaki (Voiced by Kaori Mizuhashi)
A dependable and mature figure.
She's a broad-minded G-cup.
---------------------------
The student with the most gorgeous figure in the entire Academy.
The swirling pheromones that she emits make her the epitome of a "voluptuous lady".
She loves her fellow classmates, and is a great conversationalist,
allowing her to skillfully find the appeal in others.
With her ability to find the best in everyone,
she is the one many of the students turn to discuss their problems.

▼Character song
[previewyoutube=R93iwnfnKgU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Character introduction ③ - Mio ＆Nanami
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36246473/86a47917f4a848d3090188eb0350847c2ae4af30.jpg[/img]
◆Mio Aiba (Voiced by Rena Maeda)
Secret flower enthusiast.
She has trouble socializing with others.
---------------------------
A cool beauty who rarely shows any emotion.
Her taciturn nature can lead to misunderstandings,
but she's actually just very shy and has difficulty handling relationships with other people.

▼Character song
[previewyoutube=-KHdGDqNYek;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36246473/24aeb3e1b767676168a9bdc798bd84bcf5d563da.jpg[/img]
◆Nanami Ginjo (Voiced by Rika Tachibana)
Heiress to a conglomerate.
She loves being relied upon.
---------------------------
The class representative for Hinata's class, and the only daughter of the head of the Ginjo Conglomerate.
Always presents herself in an elegant and humble way, and has the complete support of her classmates.
She loves being relied on and can't help but extend a helping hand to those in need.

▼Character song

◆Berune Orenji (Voiced by Riko Koike)
A modern-day damsel bubbling with curiosity.
She seems extremely interested in her fellow classmates (perhaps a bit too much?)
---------------------------
The student who sits next to Hinata.
With her bright and friendly demeanor, she quickly makes friends with the new transfer student.
She continues to believe in Hinata even after she is framed, and joins her in her adventures.
She tries hard but often clumsily messes things up, many times ending up having to be saved by Hinata.
She has a tendency to stick very close to Hinata.

Self-titled Blood of the High King.
Her right hand always seems to be throbbing.
---------------------------
A strange character who claims to be "of the blood of the High King."
Apparently has ominous dark powers contained in her right hand.
Highly narcissistic, she often makes bold proclamations that appear to have some kind of deeper meaning.

◆Hinata Akatsuki (Voiced by Saki Ono)
An extremely positive transfer student who strives to restore the Grand Garden.

---------------------------
The heroine of this story. The first ever transfer student in the 100-year history of Belles Fleurs Academy.
An extremely positive character. She has always dreamed of getting into Belles Fleurs, with its beautiful Grand Garden.
In order to restore peace and harmony to the Academy, she sets out on fantastic adventures with her friends.
